title: From Ripple to Boundary: Deterministic Impact Boundaries for LLM-Based Software Evolution
title_zh: 从涟漪到边界：面向基于 LLM 的软件演化的确定性影响边界

paragraphs.en: 用知识图谱与Merkle DAG将设计变更影响分析转化为确定性结构操作，保障LLM驱动的软件演化安全。 The landscape of software evolution is undergoing a fundamental paradigm shift in the era of Large Language Models. As industrial software engineering increasingly transitions toward design-driven code generation, the bottleneck of evolution has shifted from writing code to maintaining deterministic consistency between multi-source design assets and the generated code. When a design asset changes, LLM agents currently lack a deterministic impact boundary to identify which code must be evolved, leading to two failure modes: hallucinating missing changes or breaking unrelated code. Probabilistic approaches, such as semantic retrieval or text-based diffing, fail to capture the structural ripple effects across highly interconnected design dependencies. We propose a paradigm shift from probabilistic semantic retrieval to deterministic structural constraints. We formalize the design assets as a Knowledge Graph and organize them into a content-addressed Merkle Directed Acyclic Graph. Our key insight reveals a topological isomorphism between the logical ripple effect of a design change and the content hash propagation within the DAG. By leveraging this, we transform ambiguous impact analysis into verifiable structural operations. Through a two-phase diffing process, we extract a precise causal chain that defines the exact modification boundary. This boundary enables deterministic context injection, providing the LLM agent with strictly scoped code and design updates, thereby fundamentally guaranteeing evolution safety. As a by-product, the KG serves as an agent-queryable knowledge base for natural language design retrieval. Early deployment on a large-scale industrial payment platform demonstrates that our mechanism successfully computes the exact impact boundary and generates incremental code modifications that meet the expected design changes.
paragraphs.zh: 通过知识图谱与Merkle DAG将设计变更影响分析转化为确定性的结构化操作，以保障LLM驱动的软件演化安全。在大语言模型时代，软件演化的格局正在经历一场根本性的范式转变。 随着工业软件工程日益转向设计驱动的代码生成，演化的瓶颈已从编写代码转移到维护多源设计资产与生成代码之间的确定性一致性上。 当设计资产发生变更时，目前的LLM智能体缺乏确定性的影响边界来识别哪些代码必须演化，从而导致两种失败模式：幻觉出缺失的变更，或破坏无关的代码。 概率性方法，如语义检索或基于文本的差异比对，无法捕捉高度互联的设计依赖之间的结构性涟漪效应。 我们提出一种范式转变：从概率性的语义检索转向确定性的结构约束。 我们将设计资产形式化为知识图谱，并将其组织成基于内容寻址的Merkle有向无环图。 我们的核心洞察揭示了设计变更的逻辑涟漪效应与DAG内内容哈希传播之间的拓扑同构关系。 通过利用这一点，我们将模糊的影响分析转化为可验证的结构化操作。 通过两阶段差异比对过程，我们提取出一条精确的因果链，该因果链定义了确切的修改边界。 该边界支持确定性的上下文注入，为LLM智能体提供严格限定范围的代码与设计更新，从而从根本上保障演化安全。 作为副产品，知识图谱可作为可供智能体查询的知识库，用于自然语言设计检索。 在一个大规模工业支付平台上的早期部署表明，我们的机制成功计算出确切的影响边界，并生成符合预期设计变更的增量代码修改。
